task.description:
Independently re-run mix test yourself -- do not trust TEST-RUNNER's report alone, per your own standard procedure and this run's own precedent (every gate in this run has independently re-derived rather than trusted the prior step, several times catching real gaps that way -- keep that discipline here too). Then confirm every one of REQ-063's six acceptance criteria (read them directly from docs/requirements.yaml, not from any prior handoff's paraphrase) is satisfied against the actual shipped code/tests, not against any step's summary.

This run has an unusually deep verification history worth being aware of, not repeating: the test-design gate (Step 3b) FAILed twice and required two full rework cycles on a real Sandbox/connection-pooling bug before passing on the third attempt -- if you want the detail, handoffs/WF02-REQ063-20260818/step-03b-test-design-gate.json's three result blocks (only the last is current; read git log on that file if you want the full history) document a real, subtle bug that was found and fixed, not glossed over. Your own check should still independently verify current-state correctness, not re-litigate that history.

Check docs/requirements.yaml and docs/status/requirement_status.yaml for staleness relative to what actually shipped. Also confirm: decision 0006 (docs/migration/decisions/0006-identity-tables-schema-per-tenant.md) is the record this requirement executes against -- check whether its own text needs any update now that D1 has actually shipped (e.g. does it still read as a forward-looking proposal in places where it should now read as done), though note decision records aren't normally revised after the fact just because their content shipped -- use judgement on whether anything here actually needs updating versus is fine as historical rationale.

Two incidental-finding issues were filed during this run and are NOT this run's job to resolve, just confirm they're correctly out of scope: docs/issues/ISS-0047.yaml (a pre-existing Identity.insert_or_fetch/4 race on username, found during test rework) and docs/issues/ISS-0048.yaml (pre-existing orphaned Postgres schemas, found during the same rework's verification).
